From the item “UN Acts on Hungary” along with flashback picturisation, the following US Ambassador Dvlgn speaks. "I think there is great doubt that Mr. Kadar and his Soviet masters know in which direction the wheel of history is turning. They seem to lie trying with all their might to wrench it out of its natural path. But surely it cannot for ever be made to turn in a direction which causes so much death and fear and suffering for millions of people. The faith of the sponsors of this resolution is that the wheel of history can with God’s help and steadfast human effort, be made to move towards justice and truth. The greatest danger which we face in this difficult and tragic matter is that we will give in to despair. The most necessary quality for us, therefore, is steadfastness We know what is right. Although there is considerable physical power behind the thing which is wrong, those who wield that power are human beings who can be brought to change their minds. It is not only in our interests, but in their own as well, that that change should occur. Until it does, they will continue to be surrounded as they are today, by bitter and hostile peoples who will turn against them the minute they have the chance"
